semiconductor_relevance: Medium — IQS Nano specializes in advanced 3D printing systems which can be utilized in the fabrication of semiconductor components, particularly in micro- and nanostructures.
summary: IQS Nano designs and manufactures ultra-high-precision 3D printing systems using two-photon polymerization (2PP) technology, enabling the creation of advanced micro- and nanostructures. Their expertise supports both research institutions and industry in developing high-performance solutions for various applications, including those relevant to the semiconductor sector.
